_comment: Data-driven parser corrections. Loaded at parse time — extend rules without code changes.
_non_cue_words_note: ONLY true non-speakers (pure sound effects / environment) belong here — they are dropped to stage_direction and never voiced. Generic SPEAKING roles (VOICE, MAN, WOMAN, CROWD, SOLDIER, GHOST, ...) and devices that carry speech (PHONE, RADIO, TV, INTERCOM) are NOT listed: the parser now voices them at low confidence and flags them in Review (see _GENERIC_ROLES in parser.py), so real spoken lines are never silently dropped.
